control_profile: Causal 28-day BTC state budgets, exposure-reducing multi-day residual-trend protection, seven-day overlapping cohorts, volatility scaling, drawdown brakes, position stops and turnover throttling.
falsifier: A 2-day residual-trend protection horizon fails to improve adverse long/short price selection while preserving carry, return, fold breadth, turnover and cost resilience across the preregistered neighborhood.
formation_horizon: robust seven-day and twenty-eight-day settled funding with a twenty-eight-day BTC state, twenty-one-bar residual scale and 6-bar adverse-price protection
hypothesis: Funding carry is more durable when live crowded selections are sized against a completed 2-day idiosyncratic trend instead of the baseline one-day move; the five-point grid tests whether that protection is a plateau rather than a fitted endpoint.
rebalance_horizon: one daily cohort averaged across seven overlapping daily vintages
